# LINHAO Toys

> LINHAO Toys is a China-based OEM and ODM manufacturer of squishy toys, plush gifts and bag accessories for Amazon sellers, retailers and wholesale buyers.

## Company facts

- Name: LINHAO Toys (LINHAO Industrial Co., Ltd.)
- Website: https://linhaotoys.com
- Email: sales@lh-industrial.com
- Location: Guangdong, China
- Standard MOQ: 100 pieces per SKU (project-dependent)
- Sample lead time: 3–7 days after specs confirmed
- Mass production: typically 25–35 days after approved sample
- Export markets: 30+ countries
- Certifications: EN71 squeeze-toy testing, ASTM F963-23, CPC (documented programs)

## Product categories

- Glitter squishy toys
- Food-shape squishies
- Mini sensory / blind-box squishy mixes
- Plush comfort gifts
- Bag charms and accessories
- Emotional gift sets
